dogecoin.text: @Cointelegraph #dogecoin tweets mentions really went up in last weeks. sentiment is not bad as well. data from https://t.co/7qZ4X0cz6s https://t.co/sSrpYaZx1T

$DOGE with a big sentiment reversal on 10th April. today the price followed nicely. also had a nice #technicalanalysis bottom support. rolling #correlation with bitcoin fell. currently at a nice momentum bittsrank of 0.57. source: https://t.co/7qZ4X0cz6s https://t.co/302IFmM2sN
a lot of green returns in last 24 hours. $EOS $DGb #dogecoin with nice returns. source: https://t.co/7qZ4X0cz6s https://t.co/HZwf2ZVmNO
